content: विशेष {%a.%} .²1 Peculiar. .²2 Copious, abundant; आसीद्विशेषा फलपुष्पवृष्टिः <ls>R. 2. 14</ls>. .{@-षः@} .²1 Discrimination, distinguishing between. .²2 Distinction, difference; निर्विशेषो विशेषः <ls>Bh. 3. 50</ls>. .²3 Characteristic difference, peculiar mark, special property, speciality, differentia; <ab>oft.</ab> in <ab>comp.</ab> and translated by ‘special’, ‘peculiar’ <ab>&c.</ab>; विशेषं नाधिगच्छामो गायतो राघवस्य च <ls>Rām. 7. 94. 14</ls>; प्रत्यादिष्टविशेषमण्डनविधिः <ls>Ś. 6. 5</ls>. .²4 A favourable turn or crisis in sickness, a change for the better; अस्ति मे विशेषः <ls>Ś. 3</ls> ‘I feel better’. .²5 A limb, member; पुपोष लावण्यमयान् विशेषान् <ls>Ku. 1. 25</ls>. .²6 A species, sort, variety, kind, mode (usually at the end of <ab>comp.</ab>); पञ्चत्वाय विशेषाय कल्पते भुवनैः सह <ls>Bhāg. 11. 23. 21</ls>; भूतविशेषः <ls>U. 4</ls>; परिमलविशेषान् <ls>Pt. 1</ls>; कदलीविशेषाः <ls>Ku. 1. 36</ls>. .²7 A different or various object, various particulars (<ab>pl.</ab>); प्रासादास्त्वां तुलयितुमलं यत्र तैस्तैर्विशेषैः <ls>Me. 66</ls>, <ls n="Me.">59</ls>. .²8 Excellence, superiority, distinction; usually at the end of <ab>comp.</ab> and translated by ‘excellent’, ‘distinguished’, ‘pre-eminent’, ‘choice’, <ab>&c.</ab>; अनुभावविशेषात्तु <ls>R. 1. 37</ls>; वपुर्विशेषेषु <ls>Ku. 5. 31</ls>; <ls>R. 2. 7</ls>, <ls n="R.">6. 5</ls>; <ls>Ki. 9. 58</ls>; so आकृतिविशेषाः ‘excellent forms’, अतिथिविशेषः ‘a distinguished guest’ <ab>&c.</ab> .²9 A peculiar attribute, the eternal distinguishing nature of each of the nine {%dravyas%}; अयमस्माद् व्यावृत्त इति व्यावृत्तिबुद्धिमात्रहेतुर्विशेषः <ls>Tarka K.</ls> (these viśeṣas are said to inhere in the atoms of the Earth, Water, Light, and Air and the five eternal substances, Ether, Time, Space, Soul and Mind.); पञ्च चैव विशेषा वै तथा पञ्चेन्द्रियाणि च <ls>Mb. 12. 306. 29</ls>; <ls>Bhāg. 2. 5. 29</ls>. .²10 .³({%a%}) Individuality, particularity. .³({%b%}) A particular instance; उक्तिरर्थान्तरन्यासः स्यात् सामान्यविशेषयोः .²11 A category, predicament. .²12 A mark on the forehead with sandal, saffron <ab>&c.</ab> .²13 A word which limits or qualifies the sense of another; see विशेषण. .²14 <ab>N.</ab> of the mundane egg. .²15 (In <ab>Rhet.</ab>) A figure of speech, said to be of three kinds; it is thus defined by Mammaṭa:-- विना प्रसिद्धमाधारमाधेयस्य व्यवस्थितिः . एकात्मा युगपद्वृत्तिरेकस्यानेकगोचरा . अन्यत् प्रकुर्वतः कार्यमशक्यान्यस्य वस्तुनः . तयैव करणं चेति विशेषस्त्रिविधः स्मृतः .. <ls>K. P. 10</ls>. .²16 (In <ab>geom.</ab>) The hypotenuse.
